newsitem.title: USA: Orlando, Fla., seeks to buy Navy base site.
newsitem.headline: Orlando, Fla., seeks to buy Navy base site.

text.p: City of Orlando is negotiating with the Navy to buy the Orlando Naval Training Center site, but the two remain far apart on the price, the Orlando Sentinel reported Wednesday.
The city offered $1 million for the 1,100-acre base site in north Orlando, while the Navy is seeking $13.5 million.

The center's basic and intermediate training schools have already been closed as part of a national effort to cut military costs. The base's nuclear propulsion school is scheduled to close in early 1999.
The city hopes to reach an agreement by mid-July to buy the land and sell parcels for development of homes and businesses.
